integrity: The universal bounds follow from two pointwise inequalities on the complete occupancy partition list. Endpoint laws are explicit and their three-wise independence is proved from exchangeability, symbol symmetry, and the exact pair/triple collision moments. Enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The exact interval is proved for five coordinates and \(q\ge5\).
Specific three-independent hashing schemes can satisfy extra algebraic restrictions and need not fill the entire generic interval.
The originality search was targeted rather than exhaustive over older design-theoretic terminology.
title: Sharp five-key birthday envelope under three-wise-independent hashing
